name: Chicken Handi
description: Creamy Pakistani chicken handi cooked in a rich tomato-yogurt masala and finished gently with cream.
ingredients: 2 green chilies and fresh coriander, for garnish
method: Heat oil in a heavy pan over medium heat and cook the onion until lightly golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and chicken. Fry for 5–7 minutes until the chicken changes colour and begins to brown.
Add blended tomatoes, red chili, coriander powder and salt. Cook uncovered until the tomatoes reduce and the masala becomes glossy.
Lower the heat. Add the whisked yogurt gradually while stirring and cook until the masala thickens again and oil appears at the edges.
Cover and cook gently until the chicken is fully cooked, adding only a small splash of water if the masala starts sticking.
Reduce the heat to low, stir in the cream and garam masala, and simmer gently for 3–5 minutes without a hard boil.
Taste for seasoning, garnish with green chilies and coriander, and serve hot.
tips: Add yogurt over moderate-to-low heat and stir to reduce the chance of splitting.
After adding cream, keep the heat gentle so the sauce remains smooth.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate covered for up to 2 days. Reheat until the chicken and sauce are piping hot throughout.
